svg.title: PostgreSQL Major Upgrade — 7-Phase Playbook
svg.desc: Sequential flow of the Ansible-based PostgreSQL cluster upgrade from PG13 to PG18, organized into 7 phases: Setup, Preflight, Preparation, Upgrade, Rsync, Start Services, Post-Upgrade.
svg.text: ⬇ Production downtime window spans phases ④ → ⑥ (Upgrade → Rsync → Start Services)
← ④→⑤→⑥ flows right to left in this row →
